entries.title: A recurring whole marks prohibition rather than descriptive action

source_evidence.quote:
The combined GDT010/GDT064/GDT267/GDT269 picture is now more precise: q is a
reusable outer rendering on the same PAGE_HOST, it tends earlier inside lines,
and in this q13 panel it tends toward the earlier eligible record even after
exact host/page conditioning. It is not yet a universal record ordinal—GDT268
gave only a weak same-direction Stars echo—and it has no assigned meaning.

entries.title: A recurring whole marks temporal precedence without causing the next state

source_evidence.quote:
The unchanged GDT267 panel contains 632 q-or-bare group occurrences. Exact
`PAGE_HOST × page` conditioning leaves 30 movable strata, 211 occurrences,
12 hosts, and all nine pages. The q/earlier association remains positive:
Mantel–Haenszel OR 1.990, conditional U +6.290, exact occurrence-level two-sided diagnostic p 0.0380, and page-cluster sign-flip p 0.0214. Seven of nine page scores are positive.

This removes the simplest alternative that GDT267 merely compared different
host vocabularies on earlier and later records. The same opaque PAGE_HOST can
occur with q and bare rendering, and q remains earlier-associated within exact
page/host strata.

entries.title: A recurring whole distributes a predicate over members rather than forming one collective

source_evidence.quote:
The relation inventory is highly asymmetric:

| relation class | rows |
|---|---:|
| PROXIMITY | 225 |
| ATTACHMENT | 73 |
| ENCLOSURE_OR_CONTACT | 7 |
| ARRAY_OR_GROUP | 5 |

Most stable-prefix occurrences are proximity descriptions.  The gain is only
five rows, so it is not evidence for a rich relation vocabulary.  Exact raw
families provide an important counterexample: on 112 cross-folio-covered rows
they score 65 correct versus 80 for the section baseline (`-.134`), with 6
paired wins and 21 losses.

root_qualifications: IDEA43 narrows the already retained forbidden/required IDEA28 to prohibition. This is retained as an explicit specialization, not three wholly novel mechanism families. A descriptive verb may occur in prohibited discourse without marking prohibition itself; future method review must locate scope independently.

IDEA44 separates semantic event order from inscription position. Temporal language may appear in causal contexts; consequence correlation does not refute temporal marking. Existing GDT269 q-position association is motivation only and licenses no temporal reading.

IDEA45 distinguishes member-level predicate scope from group-level scope. Uniform outcomes are compatible with each-member predication; group descriptions and distributivity may overlap for some predicates. The primary ARRAY_OR_GROUP class is visible geometry, not semantic quantification.

The peer receipt retains stale design hashes for43/44; root separately computes the current canonical design hashes from exact registered/raw proposal equality. File hashes and all source spans match. Original proposals and raw records are unchanged.
